summary: CNB Financial Corporation filed an 8-K (Item 8.01) announcing a common share repurchase program approved by its Board on May 12, 2026. The plan authorizes repurchase of up to 500,000 shares for an aggregate price not exceeding $15 million, effective June 10, 2026 through June 10, 2027. Repurchases may occur via open market or private transactions in compliance with Exchange Act rules. No price per share, premium, or advisor is stated. The program replaces a 2025 plan expiring June 10, 2026. Watch for actual buyback pace vs. authorization; no risk-arb as this is an open-market issuer program.
